name: Omila Content Tag Assistant
author: omila

sections.description:
Omila Content Tag Assistant Tag Generator is a tool that helps users create relevant and SEO-friendly tags for their content in seconds. If you want to save or export the generated tags as a PDF, the DLScribe website can be used to download and keep a copy for offline access, sharing, or future reference.

Features

  • ⚡ One-click tag generation from post title + content
  • 🏷️ Smart keyword extraction with bigram (two-word phrase) detection
  • ✅ Click to select/deselect suggested tags before applying
  • 🔄 Optional auto-generate on post save
  • ⚙️ Works with Classic Editor and Gutenberg (Block Editor)
  • 🔒 100% private — all processing done on your server, no external API calls
  • 🎛️ Configurable: max tags, minimum word length, custom stopwords
  • 📄 Support for any public post type (posts, pages, custom post types)

How It Works

  1. Open any post editor
  2. Write your content
  3. Find the Tag Assistant panel in the sidebar
  4. Click ⚡ Generate Tags
  5. Click the suggested tags to select/deselect
  6. Click ✅ Apply Selected Tags
  7. Save your post — done!

Privacy

This plugin does not send any data to external servers. All tag extraction happens locally using PHP on your own WordPress installation.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the omila-content-tag-assistant folder to /wp-content/plugins/
  2. Activate the plugin through Plugins > Installed Plugins
  3. Configure settings under Settings > Tag Assistant
  4. Open any post and use the Tag Assistant sidebar panel
sections.faq:
Does this plugin need an API key?

No. Everything runs locally on your server — no external services required.

Does it work with Gutenberg?

Yes! It works with both the Classic Editor and the Gutenberg block editor.

Can I use it with custom post types?

Yes. Go to Settings > Tag Assistant and enable the post types you want.

What language does it support?

Currently optimized for English content. The stopword list is in English.
